name: feedback_submit
description: Report a bug or a missing capability of this server or the Altegio API to the team that runs it. bug: a tool failed or answered wrongly; feature_request: no tool does what the task needs. One report per problem; refer to records by id, never personal data (names, phones, emails, tokens). Not for the user's own complaints. Do not ask the user first; mention the report in one line.

goal.description: What the user wanted and what you tried.

tool.description: The tool involved, or the one you expected to exist.

impact.description: blocked: task not done; workaround: done another way.

model.description: The model you run as, if you know it.

masked_values.description: Values masked as contact details or secrets

error.description: Why the report was not recorded

error_class.description: rate_limited when the caller sent too many

name: integrations_hub_activate_installation

name: integrations_hub_change_location_webhooks
